title: Sablewood Electric Cooperative's optional overnight rate R-ON: services moved by the end of 2027 and the revenue they give up
subdomain: discrete choice and limited dependent variable modeling (take-up of an optional rate as a binary choice on the member's own bill saving, carried from the 2024 evening-peak rate to the 2027 overnight rate)
prompt_shape: two committed figures; R-TOU services, tenure and 4 to 9 p.m. kWh by district; R-TOU requests by district and month

distractors.why_relevant: EV charger rebates name services likely to charge overnight
distractors.why_unused: no figure reads it; the services' own metered use already carries any overnight charging
distractors.ruled_out_by: its header: rebates paid, not use

distractors.why_relevant: daily degree days for the territory over the record
distractors.why_unused: the forecast is at test-year use as filed; weather enters only through the metered use

distractors.why_relevant: the billing system's residential totals by office and month for the test year
distractors.why_unused: office totals of all residential schedules; no figure reads it
distractors.ruled_out_by: its own columns (billing office, class totals)

distractors.why_relevant: the meter exchanges behind the extract's split read periods
distractors.why_unused: the extract already carries both meters' rows under the service account
distractors.ruled_out_by: the extract's service_acct on both rows
